sources.title: A Quantitative and Qualitative Evaluation of LLM-Based Explainable Fault Localization (AutoFL, FSE2024)
sources.support: Pages1 and3–6:bounded function interaction retrieves covered classes/methods and implementations/documentation, followed by a separate final localization prediction. Repository navigation avoids presenting the entire codebase at once. This is a mechanism reference, not ARE performance evidence or an AutoFL replication.

sources.title: LocAgent: Graph-Guided LLM Agents for Code Localization (ACL2025)
sources.support: Abstract:directed heterogeneous representations capture code structure and dependencies for multi-hop localization. Our file grouping is not this graph-navigation mechanism. Transfer to our canonical Java/runtime pipeline is an inference requiring implementation and verification; no paper score is attributed to ARE.

local_gap: R1b tests order/grouping of the same short source windows, not full method boundaries, verified source dependency edges or iterative navigation. A source-reach or presentation gain alone cannot demonstrate deeper fault reasoning.
candidate_next_hypothesis: Source-bound complete-method views plus bounded navigation can discriminate faulty implementation behavior better than flat450-character excerpts, without ranking by coverage volume.
prerequisites: Finish and audit r1b native quality before selecting next campaign; no post-hoc edits to its gate or model answers.
Build a source-only canonical Java method-span/dependency index; validate exact source bytes, overload/nested/dollar-name identity and incomplete syntax cases independently.
Connect observed method facts only where existing compiled-ID/probe/XML bindings justify them. Command-phase coverage is not test-exclusive causality; unobserved/missing cases remain eligible.
Distinguish equal-delivered-input presentation tests from equal-access adaptive navigation tests explicitly. Both arms need the same source/runtime tools, budgets, model and missing-evidence policy.
Use a strong covered-method navigation comparator rather than a deliberately weaker source-only control; account every acquisition, index, request and failure cost.
Freeze new prospective quality/cost gates; development cannot substitute for genuinely disjoint trustworthy confirmation.
claim_ceiling: Research hypothesis only; no new method-level quality, baseline reproduction or superiority proven
open_questions: Can existing pinned Java/JaCoCo artifacts supply exact complete method spans without installing another compiler or reading reference labels?
Does adaptive navigation improve quality beyond a strong equal-access baseline at the same cumulative token/tool budget?
What disjoint/native confirmation population can verify a development gain without reusing exposed answers?
